574-1981-2415-6094.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-1981-2415-6094.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Simic Growth Chamber.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Simic Growth Chamber from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

348-1152-3191-3220-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-3191-3220-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Kairi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Kairi and any creature not part of the combo.
When Kairi dies, it and Golgari Germination triggers.
Resolve the Kairi trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

1274-2034-5086-5183-7824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1274-2034-5086-5183-7824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

1563-2457-4785-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2263-5256-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill five cards.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill five cards.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
2263-5256-6972.notes: If Geralf's Mindcrusher starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

When Stag Beetle enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

140-4484-4871-5643-6797.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
140-4484-4871-5643-6797.notablePrerequisites: You've lost X or more life this turn.
140-4484-4871-5643-6797.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Phantom Train abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
140-4484-4871-5643-6797.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1734-5987-6797.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2921-3991-5987.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1651-3340-6441-6871.description:
Activate Bootleggers' Stash by tapping it, as it's a land due to Toph, creating two Treasure tokens due to Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Bootleggers' Stash.
Repeat.

3918-4222-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that share a creature type.

1018-4050-6977.description:
Cast Emptiness for its evoke cost by paying {W}{W}.
When Emptiness enters, its first ability and evoke ability trigger.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Emptiness, adding {W}.
Resolve Emptiness's evoke trigger, failing to sacrifice it as it's no longer on the battlefield.
Resolve Emptiness's first trigger, returning Skullwinder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Skullwinder enters, it triggers, returning Emptiness from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Skullwinder, adding {W}.
Repeat.

Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Kragma Butcher.

2961-6553-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, False Demise triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.

1479-3678-5700-5701-6664.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3678-5700-5701-6664.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

5226-5478-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
5226-5478-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat.

1274-2811-3490-4659.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2811-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

849-4050-6115.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ozox, adding {1}.
When Ozox dies, it and Anax trigger.
Resolve the Ozox trigger, creating a legendary 2/1 Jumblebones creature token.
Resolve the Anax trigger, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Jumblebones and the other creature token, adding {1}{B}.
When Jumblebones dies, it triggers, returning Ozox from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ozox by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Echoes of Eternity triggers, creating a copy of the Sensei's Divining Top spell.
Resolve both Sensei's Divining Top spells.
Activate the nontoken Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate the token Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top, and causing you to put the token Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

3982-4872-5003.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Living Lore.
Living Lore does not have summoning sickness.
3982-4872-5003.description:
Deal combat damage to a player or permanent using Living Lore.
Living Lore triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Living Lore dies, its reflexive ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Living Lore trigger, causing you to cast Time Warp from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Living Lore from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
As Living Lore enters the battlefield, choose to exile Time Warp from your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

678-1308-4050-4151.description:
Cast Vishgraz either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{B}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Vishgraz enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating six 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Vishgraz, adding {W}.
When Vishgraz dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Vishgraz from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Phyrexian Mites, adding {2}{B}{G}.
Repeat.

2068-2423-4283.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
Whisper does not have summoning sickness.
2068-2423-4283.description:
Activate Whisper by tapping it, sacrificing Bounding Krasis and any other creature you control, targeting any other creature card in your graveyard.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Whisper's ability, targeting Bounding Krasis.
Resolve the copy of Whisper's ability, returning Bounding Krasis from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bounding Krasis enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Whisper.
Resolve the original Whisper ability, returning the targeted creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Obscuring Aether, adding {1}.

731-1972-5280.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U} if each opponent has three or more poison counters, or {6}{U}{U}{U} otherwise
731-1972-5280.description:
Cast Echo of Eons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing each player to discard their hands and draw seven cards.
Nekusar triggers for each card your opponents draw.
Resolve the first trigger, causing the opponent to get a poison counter.
If the opponent has ten or more poison counters, they lose the game as a state-based action.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger.
If needed, cast Echo of Eons from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hands and draw seven cards.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-2781-5210.notablePrerequisites: Liliana has at least four loyalty counters.
2438-2781-5210.description:
Sacrifice Felidar Guardian to Carrion Feeder to put a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Activate Liliana's -3 ability to return Felidar Guardian to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, exile Liliana and return it to the battlefield with 5 loyalty.
Repeat.
